summary: Reproduced at 6565dee474d3. With fn1 (raises) registered before fn2 (prints CB2) on one Cleanupper, normal interpreter exit reported fn1's RuntimeError through weakref's exit processing and never ran fn2 (CB2 not printed; exit code 0). Calling _shutdown() directly also raised RuntimeError before fn2 ran.
what_ran: repro.py runs two fresh child Pythons: one registers fn1 and fn2 on a module-level Cleanupper and exits normally; the other calls c._shutdown() directly. The parent inspects stdout/stderr.
limits: CPython 3.12 only. Only the case with one failing callback before one healthy one.
